name: Hostinger Horizons
summary: Build and launch a web app by describing your idea.
description: Hostinger Horizons generates a complete web app from a conversation, then hosts it with a domain and email on Hostinger. It targets founders who want to launch a product without technical skills.
features: Web app generated from a conversation

howToUse.title: Sign up on Hostinger Horizons
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

summary_fr: Crée et met en ligne une application web en décrivant ton idée.
description_fr: Hostinger Horizons génère une application web complète à partir d'une conversation, puis l'héberge avec nom de domaine et email chez Hostinger. Il cible les entrepreneurs qui veulent lancer un produit sans compétences techniques.
